summary: Regression test after iceReady ReferenceError fix in cliente.js/tecnico.js. Confirmed: WebRTC screen-share now works end-to-end. Video stream appears on tecnico side (blue/green canvas frames via getDisplayMedia stub) in all 3 scenarios: (1) main flow cliente-first then tecnico Ver, (2) reverse order (tecnico Ver before cliente COMEÇAR), (3) reconnect (close modal + reopen). No ReferenceError for iceReady, no 'io is not defined' errors on either page.

integration_issues.issue: Non-blocking WebRTC console warning on cliente: 'InvalidStateError: Failed to execute setRemoteDescription: Called in wrong state: stable'. Video still displays correctly (width=320, esperaOculto=True), so functionally OK; likely cliente peer connection not re-created between reconnect cycles. Consider closing/recreating RTCPeerConnection on tecnico:watch when a previous connection is stable.

Playwright click at position(150,150) on #video-ecra did NOT produce .circulo-toque on cliente nor visible #marca-clique-tec (display:none). May be a click-position/coord-mapping issue in tecnico.js when stream is letterboxed, OR the marca-clique feature has a regression. Needs manual verification. Not related to iceReady fix.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Investigate RTCPeerConnection lifecycle on cliente for reconnect: close previous pc before setting new remote description, to remove 'wrong state: stable' warning.

(Optional/minor) Verify circulo-de-toque flow manually — automated click on #video-ecra produced no .circulo-toque on cliente and no visible #marca-clique-tec. Possibly coord mapping bug in tecnico.js click handler when video is letterboxed.
critical_code_review_comments: iceReady declaration now correctly present in both cliente.js (L22) and tecnico.js (L17); window.io usage consistent. Regression fix verified.
GET /api/ice returns STUN (stun.l.google.com:19302) + TURN (openrelay.metered.ca) as expected.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for reported bug (screen-share works); 90% overall (circulo click didn't fire in automation)

seed_data_creation: None. Multiple test cliente sessions accumulated in tecnico's Historico list from prior test iterations — not blocking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Screen-share regression is FIXED. If testing circulo-de-toque again, use position on the actual video pixels (video is letterboxed inside #video-ecra container — the black bars mean click at x=150 on a wide viewport may land on the padding). Also, btn-ver-<id> uses backend session UUID, NOT the token in localStorage atlas_token_<opId>; use the FIRST btn-ver-* on the tecnico page (which corresponds to 'Online agora' section) to target the newest cliente.
rca of the issue: Reported bug: black screen on tecnico. RCA: cliente.js had `await iceReady` inside criarOferta() but the `const iceReady = fetch(...)` declaration had not been applied in the previous round; this raised ReferenceError inside criarOferta, so no WebRTC offer was ever sent to tecnico -> tecnico stayed on espera state with black video. Fix applied and verified: iceReady declared in cliente.js:22 and tecnico.js:17, and io() calls replaced with window.io(). Confirmed by (a) console captures show NO 'iceReady is not defined' / 'io is not defined' errors on either page during full flow, and (b) video-ecra.srcObject becomes non-null with videoWidth=320 and video-espera gains 'oculto' class in all 3 scenarios.
